# PhotoNow — Zero-Cloud Multimedia & Website Performance MCP Server (29 Tools)

> The #1 Zero-Cloud, Offline Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Built for AI Coding Agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Google Antigravity, Windsurf, Claude Code, and Autonomous Subagents).

PhotoNow empowers autonomous coding agents and multimodal LLMs with 29 high-performance, 100% offline, zero-cloud tools spanning **Multimedia Conversion**, **Website Performance Intelligence**, **Asset Dependency Graphs**, **Safe AST Source Code Patching**, **Atomic Rollbacks**, and **Autonomous Missions**.

- **Zero Cloud Storage**: No AWS S3, no Cloudflare R2, no remote buckets. 100% offline local processing.
- **Zero External Setup**: Bundles self-contained static FFmpeg/FFprobe binaries (`@ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg`, `@ffprobe-installer/ffprobe`) and native Sharp. No system dependencies.
- **Zero Repetitive Permission Prompts**: Native Stdio MCP server allows deep repository analysis, batch conversions, and code patching without repetitive terminal prompts.
- **Token Economy Contract**: Heavy diagnostics are computed locally; MCP responses return compact, actionable intelligence (<200 tokens for autonomous missions) with recommended next actions.
- **Non-Destructive Safety & 1-Click Rollback**: Original media files are preserved; source code modifications generate unified diffs and timestamped backups in `.photonow/backups/[operationId]/` for instant atomic rollback.

---

## Quick Reference & Live Endpoints

- **Live Web Companion**: https://photonow.vercel.app/
- **Developer MCP Hub**: https://photonow.vercel.app/ (Select `[MCP PERFORMANCE HUB]` tab)
- **Live HTTP MCP Endpoint**: https://photonow.vercel.app/api/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- **Local Stdio MCP Command**: `node <path-to-repo>/bin/mcp-server.mjs` (or `npx photo-convert-mcp`)
- **Full LLMs Specification**: https://photonow.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Sibasish2005/PhotoNowEngine
- **Architecture Blueprint**: https://photonow.vercel.app/ARCHITECTURE.md
- **Build & Usage Guide**: https://photonow.vercel.app/BUILD_FROM_SCRATCH_GUIDE.md

## Client Configuration Snippets

### Claude Desktop (`claude_desktop_config.json`)
- **Windows**: `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
- **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "photoNow": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["c:/Users/<username>/Projects/photoNow/bin/mcp-server.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Cursor IDE (`.cursor/mcp.json` or Settings > Features > MCP)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "photoNow": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["c:/Users/<username>/Projects/photoNow/bin/mcp-server.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Google Antigravity IDE (`~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "photoNow": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["c:/Users/<username>/Projects/photoNow/bin/mcp-server.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Remote / Microservice HTTP (`POST /api/mcp`)
```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "inspect_project",
    "arguments": { "projectPath": "." }
  }
}
```

## Complete 29-Tool Directory by Domain

### 1. Multimedia Foundation (8 Tools)
- `convert_image`: Convert single image to WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG with quality, rotation, ink filters.
- `convert_batch`: Batch folder image conversion with recursion filters (skips `.git`, `node_modules`).
- `convert_video`: Transcode and compress video containers (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV) using static FFmpeg.
- `extract_audio`: Extract audio tracks from video to MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG.
- `convert_audio`: Transcode standalone audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG, FLAC) with sample rate tuning.
- `extract_poster_frame`: Capture crisp video snapshot frame at sub-second timestamps.
- `get_media_info`: Unified metadata inspector (resolution, codecs, bitrate, sample rates, alpha channel).
- `optimize_for_agent`: Downscale high-res UI screenshots to compact WebP under 1568px to protect LLM context windows.

### 2. Website Performance Auditing & Diagnostics (9 Tools)
- `analyze_media`: Inspect single asset for performance bottlenecks, sizing, format efficiency, and LCP status.
- `analyze_web_assets`: 5-axis website media audit with PhotoNow performance score (0-100), top issues, and savings estimates.
- `find_oversized_assets`: Filter assets exceeding dimensional or byte thresholds (e.g. >1920px or >200KB).
- `find_inefficient_formats`: Pinpoint legacy formats (photographic PNGs, uncompressed JPEGs, animated GIFs).
- `find_duplicate_assets`: Perceptual 64-bit dHash gradient difference and SHA-256 duplicate clustering.
- `find_responsive_opportunities`: Detect high-resolution assets lacking responsive `<picture>` or `srcset` variants.
- `test_web_performance`: Web auditor reporting mobile 4G latency, simulated LCP candidates, and bandwidth waste.
- `get_web_performance_summary`: Cached instant retrieval of previous audit snapshots by `testId`.
- `compare_web_performance`: Compute deltas, byte savings, and metric improvements between before and after tests.

### 3. Performance Booster & Optimization (3 Tools)
- `generate_optimization_plan`: Formulate actionable optimization plan with unique `planId`, impact ratings, and target paths.
- `optimize_web_assets`: Execute plan safely via native Sharp. Non-destructive by default (`.photonow/optimized/`).
- `verify_optimization`: Verify measured file size reductions, codec integrity, and generate local HTML/Markdown reports.

### 4. Asset Dependency Graph & AST Understanding (3 Tools)
- `inspect_project`: Deep scanner detecting framework (Next.js App/Pages Router, Vite, Nuxt, Astro), routes, and assets.
- `get_asset_usage`: Trace asset usage chain (`Route ➔ Component ➔ SourceFile`), references count, and LCP candidate status.
- `find_unused_assets`: Pruning intelligence categorizing dead assets into safety tiers (`SAFE`, `LIKELY`, `UNCERTAIN`).

### 5. Execution, Safe Patching & Runtime (5 Tools)
- `check_performance_budget`: Evaluate project media against budgets (max page bytes, max image bytes, hero weight).
- `verify_runtime_performance`: Separate real browser `OBSERVED` metrics from local network `SIMULATED` models.
- `generate_source_patch`: Generate unified diffs updating image tags (`<Image>`, `<img>`) and imports in source code.
- `apply_source_patch`: Apply source patch safely with automated backups in `.photonow/backups/[operationId]/`. Requires `confirmApply: true`.
- `rollback_operation`: 1-click atomic rollback restoring modified source code and assets to pre-patch state.

### 6. Autonomous High-Level Mission (1 Tool)
- `optimize_project`: 10-step autonomous mission orchestrator (`DISCOVER ➔ UNDERSTAND ➔ ANALYZE ➔ MEASURE ➔ DIAGNOSE ➔ PLAN ➔ PATCH ➔ OPTIMIZE ➔ VERIFY ➔ REPORT`). Returns <200 token summary with next-action guidance.

## Agent Prompt Recipes

| Task | Prompt Example to Give Claude Desktop / Cursor / Antigravity |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Inspect Architecture** | *"Use PhotoNow to inspect the architecture of this project and summarize its routes and media assets."* |
| **Audit Media** | *"Run analyze_web_assets on this directory and tell me what the biggest performance bottlenecks are."* |
| **Find Dead Assets** | *"Find all unreferenced images in this project and identify which ones are safe to delete."* |
| **LCP Analysis** | *"Check if our hero banner is an LCP candidate and trace which React components reference it."* |
| **Optimize & Patch** | *"Generate an optimization plan for our public assets, convert them to WebP, and patch our Next.js page components safely."* |
| **Atomic Rollback** | *"Revert the changes from operation op_abc123 using rollback_operation."* |
| **Autonomous Mission** | *"Run optimize_project in dry-run mode on this repository and tell me what performance gains we can achieve."* |
| **Media Conversion** | *"Convert all images in C:/Assets to WebP at 80% quality without asking for shell permissions."* |
| **Extract Audio** | *"Extract the soundtrack from demo.mp4 as an MP3 file at 192kbps."* |

## Test & Quality Verification

All 29 tools, security boundaries, and autonomous workflows are verified via standardized test suites:
- `npm run test:mcp`: 29/29 tools passing via native Stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 (100%).
- `npm run test:sandbox`: 15/15 external client checks in an isolated Next.js sandbox (100%).
- `npm run test:security`: 15/15 enterprise defensive checks (SSRF, traversal, bomb limits) (100%).
- `npm run test:http`: 10/10 JSON-RPC 2.0 HTTP protocol compliance checks (100%).
- `npm run test:unit`: Core engine unit tests for scanner, AST analyzer, and asset graph (100%).
- `npm run test:mission`: 10-step autonomous mission and token budget contract (<200 tokens) (100%).
- `npm test`: Runs all core suites sequentially.
